# Conversation to spec (Matt Pocock)

Turns what you've discussed into a structured spec and files it in your issue tracker.

- Source: https://github.com/mattpocock/skills
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mattpocock/skills/main/skills/engineering/to-spec/SKILL.md
- Author: Matt Pocock
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/conversation-to-spec-matt-pocock-8871a037

Takes the current conversation and writes it up as a spec with problem statement, solution, user stories, implementation and testing decisions, and scope, then publishes it to the project's issue tracker. It doesn't interview you again; it just synthesizes. Manual use only (run /to-spec), and it needs access to your tracker, for example via the gh CLI.

**Try asking:**
- "/to-spec"
- "/to-spec and file it as a GitHub issue"
- "/to-spec for the export feature we just discussed"
